Compositions

Version 36 / finish-by-5-2 boards / seven items / refreshed 25 Oct 2026

How these boards are built and scored

Every board is what the plan realistically reaches by 5-2, not a level-9 cap. Reroll targets are 3★; other three-cost or cheaper units are 2★; four-costs stay 1★ unless the plan is Fast 8; five-costs only appear at level 8. Each board carries seven finished items: three on the tank, three on the carry and one on a secondary carry.

Opponents are the ranked meta at that point of the game: boards rebuilt from the official API stage snapshots (stage 4 lobby 80%, stage 3 lobby 20%), weighted by popularity and given seven items from their own most-used equipment. Each pair is fought with eight fresh seeds on both sides on the version 36 engine, neutral weather, no Seals.

Expected at 5-2 is fought on the boards you actually have at 5-2: 200 full-game shop simulations (shared pool with seven meta opponents, native odds, income and XP) record which copies were found and what level was reached, and the most common of those real boards are fought and weighted by how often they happen. Missing one of four 3★ targets therefore counts as a slightly weaker board, not a failed one. Tier: S at least 75%, A at least 65%, B at least 55%. Full board is the score when every star and item shown is reached; Low roll is the worst case: the carry and every other 3★ target one star lower, with the best item holder for that board.
